title: REQ · Frontend tsc --noEmit passes with Node test types
summary: Declare Node types so tests using node:fs, node:path and process type-check
description: Context: tests/layout.test.tsx imports node:fs and node:path and uses process.cwd(), but tsconfig types is ["vite/client","vitest/globals"] and @types/node is not installed, giving TS2307/TS2591. Desired behavior: tsc --noEmit is clean. Expected result: zero type errors. Why: type-check is a gate for the assembled frontend.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, when devDependencies are read, then @types/node is listed
Given tsconfig.json, when compilerOptions.types is read, then it includes "node" alongside "vite/client" and "vitest/globals"
Given game/frontend, when tsc --noEmit runs, then no TS2307 or TS2591 errors remain
technical_constraints: Do not loosen strict or skipLibCheck settings
